label: Stormer 1928 echo delay series (Faizullin 2010, arXiv:1007.4054)
source: Faizullin, R.T. (2010). 'Geometrical joke(r?)s for SETI.' arXiv:1007.4054. Citing Stormer & van der Pol 1928–1929 coordinated Eindhoven–Oslo experiments.
citation: Stormer, C. (1928). 'Short Wave Echoes and the Aurora Borealis.' Nature, 122, 681. van der Pol, B. (1928). Nature, 122, 878–879.
note: Five series of echo delays (seconds) registered during the October 1928–November 1929 experiments. Transmitter: PCJJ Eindhoven, 31.4 m wavelength. Measured by stopwatch, 0.5 s estimated precision.
